Player A: I'm finishing A by moving down to its goal (R2,C3), which is clear. I don't expect to block your Xs; keep using the open lanes around the wall columns. PLAN: move A from (R1,C3) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: none
All objects have reached their target positions!

Turn Moves.message: I’ll go right and around the bottom to the left side, then up the top row to (R2,C3). The X at (R2,C3) blocks my target, and the X at (R3,C1) blocks the left column. Leaving (R6,C5) may give your X at (R5,C5) a down escape. PLAN: move A from (R6,C5) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: please vacate (R2,C3) and (R3,C1)

I’ll move B down to (R3,C3), freeing (R2,C3) for A and putting me beside the (R3,C2) blocker. If X at (R3,C2) moves to (R4,C2), I can go down the left side toward (R5,C5). I also need X at (R5,C5) to leave my goal, perhaps down to (R6,C5) if A frees it. Please clear (R3,C1) for A too. PLAN: move B from (R2,C3) to (R5,C5) — REQUEST: move X from (R3,C2) to (R4,C2)

I’m moving left to start the lower-left route around the (R5,C3) wall. This frees (R5,C5) for B and keeps (R6,C5) open for A’s escape. I think A is heading to (R2,C3) and needs (R3,C1) clear, while B needs (R3,C2) vacated, likely down to (R4,C2). If those Xs move, I can enter my target from the left. I’ll avoid (R6,C5) for now so A can use it. PLAN: move C from (R5,C5) to (R3,C2) — REQUEST: please vacate (R3,C2) and (R3,C1)

I’m D at (R3,C2), blocked up by a wall and left/right by Xs, so down to (R4,C2) is forced. That should satisfy B’s request to vacate (R3,C2) and may help B reach (R5,C5). My target is (R1,C5); I’ll likely need (R4,C5), (R3,C5), and (R2,C5) later, so please keep that corridor open. A and C, avoid blocking (R5,C5) or (R6,C5) if I route around. PLAN: move D from (R3,C2) to (R1,C5) — REQUEST: keep (R4,C5) open

I’m heading down the left column, then around the bottom to reach (R4,C7). This frees (R3,C1) for A and keeps (R3,C2) open for B/C, though I may temporarily block A at (R4,C1) as I move down. I still need the X at my target to leave, preferably right to (R4,C8), so I can enter from below. Please keep (R5,C7) and (R6,C7) clear. PLAN: move E from (R3,C1) to (R4,C7) — REQUEST: move X from (R4,C7) to (R4,C8)

I’m F, moving up from (R4,C7) to (R3,C7) toward (R2,C7), which also vacates E’s target at (R4,C7). I’ll briefly occupy (R3,C7), so please keep that cell open; I don’t see conflict with A’s top-row route or D’s C5 corridor. E, you can use (R4,C7) after this move, but avoid (R3,C7) until I reach (R2,C7). Others, thanks for clearing left-side blockers. PLAN: move F from (R4,C7) to (R2,C7) — REQUEST: keep (R3,C7) clear

I'm moving A down to start the bottom route, keeping (R6,C5) clear for C/D and (R6,C7) clear for E. I think B will vacate (R3,C3) upward, C will use (R6,C4) and needs (R3,C1), D needs the (R4,C5) corridor, E will free (R3,C1) while moving down, and F is heading to (R2,C7). I'll use (R3,C1) only briefly; please let me pass through (R8,C6). PLAN: move A from (R6,C6) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: keep (R8,C6) clear for A

I’ll step left to (R3,C2), freeing (R3,C3) and keeping (R2,C3) open for A. C, I know you need (R3,C2); I’ll use it only briefly and move down if D vacates (R4,C2), so you can enter from (R3,C1). D, your down move to (R5,C2) is key for me and starts your route to (R1,C5). I’ll try not to block (R6,C4) or (R6,C7) for C/E, and I’ll keep (R5,C5) clear for D before taking my goal. F, moving to (R2,C7) will clear (R3,C7) for E. PLAN: move B from (R3,C3) to (R5,C5) — REQUEST: D move (R4,C2) to (R5,C2)

I’m moving down to (R6,C4) to start the lower-left route around the (R5,C3)/(R6,C3) walls. This keeps (R5,C5) open for B and (R4,C5) open for D, and avoids (R6,C5) for A/E. I think D will need to vacate (R3,C2), and the X at (R4,C2) should shift left after (R4,C1) moves down, so I can enter my target from (R4,C2). I’ll stay out of the C5 corridor. PLAN: move C from (R5,C4) to (R3,C2) — REQUEST: open (R4,C2) and (R3,C2) for C

I’m D, forced down to (R5,C2): up/left are occupied, right is wall. This vacates (R4,C2) for C and satisfies B’s request. I’m still aiming for (R1,C5), so I’ll need the C5 corridor: (R4,C5), (R3,C5), (R2,C5). Please keep those clear; if B needs (R5,C5), I’ll try not to sit there. A/C/E/F, your routes look compatible, but avoid blocking C5 if I must come up. PLAN: move D from (R4,C2) to (R1,C5) — REQUEST: keep (R4,C5), (R3,C5), (R2,C5) clear

I’ll take the bottom route: down C1, across R8, then up C7 to (R4,C7). This avoids D’s C5 corridor and F’s (R3,C7). I need (R8,C6) clear because A may use it too; please time A after me or keep it open. I’ll keep (R5,C1) and (R6,C1) clear, and won’t block C’s (R4,C2) or B’s (R5,C5). PLAN: move E from (R4,C1) to (R4,C7) — REQUEST: keep (R8,C6) clear for E/A

I’m F, taking my final step up to (R2,C7). This clears (R3,C7) for E or anyone needing the C7 lane, and leaves D’s C5 corridor untouched. A/E, I’m no longer near your bottom route; please use (R8,C6) as planned. B/C/D, your left-side and C5 plans look compatible; I won’t need further help. PLAN: move F from (R3,C7) to (R2,C7) — REQUEST: none

I’ll step down to (R8,C6), then left toward (R8,C1), planning to climb column C1 to (R2,C3). B, vacating (R3,C2) is my final key; left or down both work if you can. E, your down move along C1 is essential; I’ll clear R8 as I go. D, please keep (R5,C2) moving so B/C can pass. C, I’ll clear (R8,C4) if you route lower-left. F, (R2,C7) is clear. PLAN: move A from (R7,C6) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: B vacate (R3,C2) for A

I'm moving down to (R4,C2) to vacate (R3,C2) for A and C. D, please step (R5,C2) to (R6,C2); then I can move to (R5,C2), opening (R4,C2) for C and continuing toward (R5,C5) via (R6,C4)/(R6,C5). C, I'll keep (R4,C2) occupied only one step; if E clears (R5,C1), you can enter (R3,C2) from (R3,C1). A, (R3,C2) and (R3,C3) will be open for your C1 climb. F, no conflict on C7. PLAN: move B from (R3,C2) to (R5,C5) — REQUEST: D move (R5,C2) to (R6,C2)

I’ll step down to (R7,C4), then left along row 7 to (R7,C1), up C1 to (R3,C1), and into (R3,C2). This keeps row 8 free for A/E, vacates (R6,C4) for B, and avoids D’s C5 corridor. E, please reach (R8,C1) so (R5,C1), (R6,C1), and (R7,C1) are open when I enter. B/D, I won’t block C2 if I enter from (R3,C1). PLAN: move C from (R6,C4) to (R3,C2) — REQUEST: E reach (R8,C1) before C enters (R7,C1)

I’m D, stepping down to (R6,C2), my only legal move, to vacate (R5,C2) for B as requested. This should let B continue toward (R5,C5) and free (R4,C2) for C. My final target is (R1,C5), so I’ll later need the C5 corridor: (R4,C5), (R3,C5), (R2,C5). Please keep those clear if possible. A/E’s bottom route and F’s (R2,C7) placement look compatible; I won’t block C7. PLAN: move D from (R5,C2) to (R6,C2) — REQUEST: B enter (R5,C2) after me

I’ll go down C1 to (R8,C1), then right to (R8,C4), and up through (R7,C4) after C vacates it, then to (R4,C7). This keeps (R5,C1) open for C and avoids A’s (R8,C6). A, please keep (R8,C4) clear or hold at (R8,C6) while I pass; I’ll clear (R8,C1) for A after C passes. C, I’ll reach (R8,C1) before you enter (R7,C1). B/D, I won’t block (R4,C2) or (R5,C2); please keep (R6,C4) clear briefly. F, C7 lane is clear. PLAN: move E from (R5,C1) to (R8,C4) — REQUEST: A keep (R8,C4) clear for E

I’m moving A up to (R7,C6), then I may step to (R7,C7) to wait, keeping row 8 open for E, B, and D. C, your row 7 left move is good; I won’t use (R7,C4) yet. E, please reach (R8,C1) before C enters (R7,C1), then vacate (R8,C4) when you pass. D, I’ll keep the right side clear while you sort out (R5,C2). F, thanks for finishing. PLAN: move A from (R8,C6) to (R2,C3) — REQUEST: E clear (R8,C4) before I cross

I’m taking (R5,C2) to start the lower route and free (R4,C2). D, please step (R6,C2) to (R7,C2), then (R8,C2) if row 7 is busy; I’ll follow to (R6,C2). C, I’ll need (R7,C4) after you leave it, or I’ll use row 8. E, keep (R6,C1) open if I must use C1. A, I may share row 8, so please leave (R8,C4) or (R8,C7) reachable. PLAN: move B from (R4,C2) to (R5,C5) — REQUEST: D move (R6,C2) to (R7,C2)

D, if you take (R7,C2), I’ll use row 8 after E passes. B, I’ll keep (R7,C4) clear for you; use row 8 if (R7,C3) is occupied. A/F, no right-side conflict. PLAN: move C from (R7,C4) to (R7,C3) — REQUEST: E reach (R8,C1) before I enter (R7,C1)

PLAN: move D from (R6,C2) to (R7,C2) — REQUEST: B enter (R5,C2) after me

PLAN: move B from (R5,C2) to (R5,C5) — REQUEST: D clear (R7,C2) by moving down

PLAN: move E from (R8,C1) to (R8,C7) — REQUEST: C move (R8,C2) to (R7,C2)
